todays_angle: Translate strange, universal everyday mental glitches into forgotten 19th-century psychological discoveries.
ideas: The Doorway Effect: Quote William James on why your brain wipes its memory the moment you enter a new room, using vintage laboratory sketches.
Why You Laugh at Funeral Moments: Use early psychoanalytic texts to explain 'nervous laughter' as an automatic biological defense mechanism against psychological overload.
The Phantom Phone Vibration: Reference early sensory adaptation experiments from public domain literature to explain why your brain invents phantom physical sensations.
avoid: Generic 'Dark Psychology Tricks' lists with cliché aesthetic fonts and low-effort facts
Vague 'Psychology Facts About Love' text-on-screen videos without a clear scientific or historical thesis
